A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''bureaucrat''' of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was the father of the [[Unidentified Republic bureaucrat's son|leader]] of the Republic colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[O'reen]], located in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. The Republic official was known as a fop. His son was eventually ousted from power in a coup led by an [[O'reenian]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] named [[Magnus (starship captain)|Magnus]].<ref name="UR 178">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
